Interface SysMLActionFunction

All Known Subinterfaces:
PerformedActionFunction, SysMLCalculationFunction, SysMLDoActionFunction, SysMLEffectActionFunction, SysMLEntryActionFunction, SysMLExitActionFunction
public interface SysMLActionFunction
Interface to be extended to a functional interface for the function of the action, i.e. interface to be extended for the lambda function that defines the action. An example usage is as follows: 
public class MyPart extends SysMLPart
{
        @FunctionalInterface
        public interface LinearSlopeFunction extends SysMLActionFunction
        {
                Integer perform(Integer x, Integer intercept, Float slope);
        }

        @ActionFunction
        LinearSlopeFunction linearSlopeFunction;
        @Action
        SysMLAction getY;

        @Override
        public void createActionFunctions()
        {
                linearSloptFunction = (x, intercept, slope) -> {return slope * x + intercept};
        }

        @Override
        public void createActions()
        {
                getY = new SysMLAction(linearSlopeFunction, "MyAction", 0L};
        }
}
